hero.title: Empowering Minds. Shaping Tomorrow at Ponneri.
hero.copy: Sridevi Arts and Science College is a premier co-educational institution affiliated to the University of Madras, dedicated to imparting purposeful, affordable, and quality higher education to students from rural and semi-urban communities.

about.title: A Legacy of Purposeful Rural & Urban Education.
about.p1: Sridevi Arts and Science College is a leading co-educational institution in Ponneri, established in the year 2001 with a visionary commitment to impart purposeful and accessible higher education to aspiring students, particularly those hailing from rural backgrounds.
about.p2: Affiliated to the prestigious University of Madras, the college has grown into a distinguished center of learning offering 8 Undergraduate and 2 Postgraduate departments, alongside robust Physical Education and Career Placement cells. With dedicated faculty, high-tech laboratories, and strong merit scholarship support, we empower over 1,500 students each year.

programmes.title: B.Com (General)
programmes.desc: One of our premier founding departments with high-caliber faculty, advanced accounting labs, and comprehensive training in financial markets and corporate taxation.

programmes.title: B.C.A (Computer Applications)
programmes.desc: Began in 2001, providing industry-aligned training in software development, web engineering, database architecture, and mobile applications.

programmes.title: B.Sc (Computer Science)
programmes.desc: Celebrating 25 years of excellence, this department builds strong foundations in algorithms, system programming, cloud computing, and cybersecurity.

programmes.title: B.Sc (Mathematics)
programmes.desc: Renowned for producing University of Madras rank holders (including 90th and 31st university ranks) with deep analytical and quantitative rigor.

programmes.title: B.Com (Corporate Secretaryship)
programmes.desc: Specialized curriculum focusing on company secretarial practices, corporate law, auditing, governance, and business communication.

programmes.title: BBA (Business Administration)
programmes.desc: Empowering future managers and entrepreneurs through practical case studies, Bizmind Club forums, business simulations, and executive mentoring.

programmes.title: B.A (English Literature)
programmes.desc: Home to the English Literary Association, cultivating mastery in critical reading, communication, journalism, and public discourse.

programmes.title: B.A (Tamil)
programmes.desc: Fosters profound scholarship in classical and modern Tamil literature, linguistics, grammar, media studies, and cultural heritage.

programmes.title: B.Sc (Computer Science with AI)
programmes.desc: Next-generation degree integrating deep learning, neural networks, machine intelligence, natural language processing, and automated systems.

programmes.title: M.A (Tamil)
programmes.desc: Advanced master's research degree concentrating on ancient epigraphy, Sangam literature, comparative literary theory, and higher pedagogy.

programmes.title: Physical Education & Sports
programmes.desc: Expansive athletic facilities, multi-sport training grounds, inter-collegiate tournaments, martial arts, and annual athletic meets.

programmes.title: Employability & Placement Cell
programmes.desc: Dedicated corporate platform providing aptitude coaching, mock interviews, foreign university counselling, and campus recruitment drives.

usps.title: High-Tech Green Campus
usps.desc: Eco-friendly academic grounds in Krishnapuram, Ponneri, equipped with solar illumination, modern computer centers, and spacious auditoriums.

usps.title: Dedicated Placement Cell
usps.desc: Year-round employability training, campus recruitment drives, industry workshops, and dedicated support for alumni.

usps.title: Scholarships for Rural & Weaker Sections
usps.desc: Active facilitator of Tamil Nadu Postmatric SC/ST scholarships (ssp.tn.gov.in) alongside institutional merit waivers.

usps.title: Special Provisions for Women Students
usps.desc: Safe, supportive environment with specialized counseling, secure transit, and leadership platforms for girl students.

usps.title: Comprehensive College Bus Fleet
usps.desc: Safe transportation connecting Ponneri, Gummidipoondi, Minjur, Red Hills, and northern Chennai suburbs.

usps.title: Affiliated to University of Madras
usps.desc: Rigorous curriculum, recognized university degrees, seasoned professors, and consistent university rank holders.
